commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Prevents health loss and restores the solo player’s health.

commands.name: Unlimited mana
commands.description: Prevents mana consumption and restores the solo player’s mana.

commands.name: One-hit kills
commands.description: Defeats enemies with a single damaging hit from the solo player.

commands.name: Damage multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies damage dealt by the solo player from 1× to 10×.

commands.name: Set shards
commands.description: Sets the current area’s shard balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: Set essence
commands.description: Sets the active character’s essence balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.
